title: 自動車工学
subtitle: Automobile Engineering
educationalGoal: The automobile is a product of mechanical engineering and electrical engineering. Students will: (1) acquire the ability to determine basic vehicle performance. (2) acquire the ability to understand basic powertrain output characteristics.
advice: This is a basic course of in automotive engineering. We will cover the following topics. (1) History and role of automobile. (2) Automotive internal combustion engine (3) Powertrain (4) Automotive braking system (5) Driving performance (6) Production technology (7) Recycling technology
requiredKnowledge: Students must have a basic understanding of mathematics, mechanics, and thermodynamics.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate simple vehicle performance parameters.
Be able to explain simple structures and mechanisms.
Be able to explain the theoretical cycle and operating principles of an internal combustion engine.
Be able to explain the driving, turning, and stopping of cars in mechanical terms.
Be able to establish a simple equation of motion for cars.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Students can understand various automotive powertrain mechanism and explain their advandages and disadvantages. (2) Students can accurately calculate vehicle power characteristics using mechanics. (3) Students can provide a mechanical explanation of automobile driving, turning, and stopping, and can establish the corresponding equation of motion. (4) Students can explain the automotive life-cycle, from design to recycling, in their own words.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Students can understand various automotive powertrain mechanism. (2) Students can calculate basic vehicle power characteristics using mechanics. (3) Students can provide mechanical explanation of automobile driving, turning, and stopping. (4) Students can Eexplain the automotive life-cycle process, from design to recycling, in general terms.
